mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_pending_approval (approval_id, run_id, request_id, conversation_id, resolved_workspace, workspace_display_name, tool, input_json, risk_reason, operation_preview, metadata_json, context_json, created_at, expires_at, consumed, state, decision, decision_reason) VALUES (#{approvalId}, #{runId}, #{requestId}, #{conversationId}, #{resolvedWorkspace}, #{workspaceDisplayName}, #{tool}, #{inputJson}, #{riskReason}, #{operationPreview}, #{metadataJson}, #{contextJson}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{consumed}, COALESCE(#{state}, 'PENDING'), #{decision}, #{decisionReason}) ON CONFLICT(approval_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_pending_approval WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_pending_approval SET consumed = 1, update_time = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND consumed = 0

UPDATE agent_pending_approval SET state = 'DECIDED', decision = #{decision}, decision_reason = #{decisionReason}, update_time = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE agent_pending_approval SET state = 'RESUMED', update_time = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE approval_id = #{approvalId} AND state = 'DECIDED'
